_comment: Add these nodes to existing Workflow 1 after Node 8 (Mark Run Complete).
_instruction: In n8n, open Workflow 1, then manually add these nodes in order. Connect Node 9 input to Node 8 output. Ensure GITHUB_TOKEN is set in n8n environment variables.

nodes.name: Node 9: Export GeoJSON Query

parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('type', 'FeatureCollection', 'metadata', jsonb_build_object('generated_at', NOW()::text, 'run_id', (SELECT MAX(run_id) FROM staging_la_signals)::text, 'feature_count', COUNT(*)::text, 'source', 'exempt_pipeline', 'projection', 'WGS84'), 'features', jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type', 'Feature', 'geometry', b.geojson, 'properties', jsonb_build_object('lad24cd', b.lad24cd, 'la_name', COALESCE(sig.la_name, b.lad24nm), 'population', sig.population, 'ta_households_current', sig.ta_households_current, 'ta_households_prev_year', sig.ta_households_prev_year, 'ta_yoy_pct', sig.ta_yoy_pct, 'ta_trend_label', sig.ta_trend_label, 'rough_sleeping_current', sig.rough_sleeping_current, 'rough_sleeping_prev_year', sig.rough_sleeping_prev_year, 'care_leavers_semi_indep', sig.care_leavers_semi_indep, 'marac_cases', sig.marac_cases, 'marac_rate_per_10k', sig.marac_rate_per_10k, 'hb_sa_caseload', sig.hb_sa_caseload, 'housing_register', sig.housing_register, 'ro4_bb_spend_000', sig.ro4_bb_spend_000, 'ro4_nightly_spend_000', sig.ro4_nightly_spend_000, 'ro4_total_homelessness_000', sig.ro4_total_homelessness_000, 'efs_flag', COALESCE(sig.efs_flag, false), 's114_flag', COALESCE(sig.s114_flag, false), 'imd_rank_of_average_rank', sig.imd_rank_of_average_rank, 'lha_brma_name', sig.lha_brma_name, 'lha_sar_weekly', sig.lha_sar_weekly, 'lha_1bed_weekly', sig.lha_1bed_weekly, 'lha_2bed_weekly', sig.lha_2bed_weekly, 'lha_3bed_weekly', sig.lha_3bed_weekly, 'lha_4bed_weekly', sig.lha_4bed_weekly, 'supported_living_locations', COALESCE(sig.supported_living_locations, 0), 'data_quality', sig.data_quality)))) AS geojson_output FROM la_boundaries b LEFT JOIN staging_la_signals sig ON sig.lad24cd = b.lad24cd AND sig.run_id = (SELECT MAX(run_id) FROM staging_la_signals) WHERE b.geojson IS NOT NULL;

nodes._note: Uses exempt_pipeline_db credential. Returns single row with geojson_output column.

nodes.name: Node 11: Publish to GitHub
nodes._note: Publishes signals JSON + metadata via GitHub Contents API. GeoJSON (9.5MB) must be pushed via git separately.

nodes.name: Node 12 (Optional): Slack Notification
nodes._note: Optional. Requires Slack credential. Remove this node if Slack is not used.

connections.Node 8 → Node 9: Connect Node 8 (Mark Run Complete) output to Node 9 (Export GeoJSON Query) input
connections.Node 11 → Node 12: Optional — only if Slack notification is wanted

environment_variables_required: GITHUB_TOKEN — GitHub PAT with repo write scope
credentials_required: exempt_pipeline_db — PostgreSQL credential pointing to exempt_pipeline database
